title: Aathavan Apartments in Dehiwala
excerpt: A family-oriented development of 44 residences at No. 6 Carron Place, Dehiwala, with two- and three-bedroom homes, selected units with maid's quarters, rooftop amenities, solar infrastructure and parking.
body:
The development brings together 44 residences across a carefully coordinated residential building, with a mix of two-bedroom and three-bedroom homes. Selected three-bedroom apartments include maid's quarters, while each residence is planned with practical family living in mind, including separate kitchens, kitchen balconies and comfortable private spaces.

The design responds to the site, its narrow residential street and the needs of contemporary apartment living. Shared facilities include parking, a rooftop gym, outdoor exercise areas, a community hall, solar infrastructure and rainwater-management provisions.

Excello's role brings together development, architectural coordination, interior direction and build-stage collaboration. The aim is to create a calm, durable and well-resolved home environment where planning, material choices and long-term usability work together.

title: Panimozhi Club House
excerpt: A 15-room coastal retreat designed around natural light, sea breezes and the quiet rhythm of Kalkudah's shoreline.
body:
A measured response to dusk, landscape and gathering. Panimozhi Club House is a fifteen-room coastal retreat designed around natural light, sea breezes and the quiet rhythm of Kalkudah's shoreline.

The architecture keeps the plan open to the landscape, drawing daylight and greenery through the building so that arrival, rest and gathering read as one continuous coastal experience.

title: Sea Esta Villas, Mount Lavinia
excerpt: A coastal residential project balancing privacy, efficiency and a warm material character.
body:
A quiet coastal language carried through architecture and development thinking. Sea Esta is a coastal residential project balancing privacy, efficiency and a warm material character.

Each home is positioned to make the most of light and outlook, and the layouts are resolved so that everyday living feels calm, private and generous.

title: Café Kaapi
excerpt: A warm café interior combining industrial simplicity, tropical character and social spaces designed for connection.
body:
A considered link between identity, material and everyday use. Café Kaapi is a warm café interior combining industrial simplicity, tropical character and social spaces designed for connection.

Branding and space are resolved together, so the identity carries from the logo through the signage and into the room, and customers experience one coherent story the moment they arrive.

title: Bambalapitiya Residence
excerpt: A compact three-storey urban residence shaped by natural light, ventilation and carefully organised private and service spaces.
body:
A compact three-storey urban residence shaped by natural light, ventilation and carefully organised private and service spaces.

On a tight city plot, the design works section and orientation hard so that daylight and air reach the heart of the home, while private and service areas are arranged to keep everyday living calm and practical.

title: Rudra Wellness Retreat - Kalkudah
excerpt: A 25-acre wellness village combining furnished villas, a holiday retreat, lifestyle experiences and community empowerment.
body:
Rudra is a 25-acre wellness village combining furnished villas, a holiday retreat, lifestyle experiences and community empowerment.

The architecture frames the surrounding landscape, drawing daylight and greenery deep into the plan so that the buildings and their setting feel continuous, and every decision is made to slow the pace and let guests rest.
